headline: OpenAI safety employee resigns, warns company culture is broken
summary: David Robinson, who wrote OpenAI's safety reports, resigned this week and spoke out in an editorial in The Atlantic, warning that the company's culture is broken and that it isn't being careful enough about AI risk. Coverage notes Robinson fits a familiar pattern of AI-company employees who issue warnings while resigning from their jobs.
